summary.description: One to three short, natural-language lines explaining the exact weak boundary, observed configuration and affected resources. Include concrete selectors, CIDRs and ports when available; no generic warnings.
summary.title: Summary

resource_ids.description: Existing original platform IDs for every affected control or workload, including the primary resource_id.
resource_ids.title: Resource Ids

graph_refs.description: Existing node or edge IDs supporting the configuration and relationships; never invented references.
graph_refs.title: Graph Refs

observations.description: Specific observed rule values, native resource identifiers, selectors, protocols/ports and evidence paths supporting this finding.
observations.title: Observations

title.description: A concise actionable title naming the affected boundary or control and the needed change.
title.title: Title

description.description: What is misconfigured: identify the affected tier/boundary, native controls and exact observed rule or route. Do not claim live reachability from configuration alone.
description.title: Description

rationale.description: Why this configuration weakens segmentation, which workloads or tiers are affected, and any decision-changing dependency or intent assumption.
rationale.title: Rationale

resource_id.description: Primary affected control’s original platform resource ID, not its graph ID or native ID. The platform derives its display identity and scope.
resource_id.title: Resource Id

severity.description: Severity justified by the evidenced scope and impact of the boundary weakness; do not inflate based on unverified exploitation.
severity.title: Severity

status.description: FAIL for an evidenced configuration weakness; MANUAL when the recommendation depends on unconfirmed intent or dependencies; UNKNOWN when configuration is missing or denied.
status.title: Status

remediation.description: Concrete change to the named enforcement control: allowed source/destination and protocols/ports where evidenced, prerequisites and staged rollout preserving required dependencies.
remediation.title: Remediation

verification.description: Specific read-only configuration checks and owner validation of required connectivity after the change, including expected allowed and restricted flows.
verification.title: Verification

explanation.description: Readable outline with ### headings per VPC/VNet/network, #### headings per subnet tier/connectivity boundary, and short - bullet lists separated by blank lines. Introduce each network with region, address space and purpose. Explain tier placement, purpose and enforcement in one or two sentences per bullet; group equivalent default networks. No dense global paragraphs.
explanation.title: Explanation
